b: You can’t become fluent in a foreign language in ten minutes a day, even if you try for months.
On the other hand, here are a dozen things many of us can do (or do better) if we stick with it:

Three-ball juggling
Touch typing
Rubik’s Cube
Drawing
Mental math
Memorizing a deck of cards or people’s names
Meditating
History or geography
Finding joy in small things
Typography
Ukulele
Italic handwriting
Morse code
Excel and HTML
The seven minutes after minute three
“I can’t do that,” might often be more honestly reported as, “I haven’t chosen to be able to do that.”
